We evaluate ranker performance using two metrics. First, we use pairwise accuracy, which measures accuracy in selecting the positive sample from a positive (more feedback) and negative (less feedback) pair for the same context. Second, since the models will be used to rank hypotheses, we are also interested in the correlation between the model scorer rank and the the gold label rank. We measure this correlation using Spearman's ρ.
